sla.measurement: Micrometer timers on the provider, compared against the consumer-side timeout

retry.backoff: exponential with full jitter, 100ms base, 1s cap

fallback: Return 503 problem+json to the SPA. No cached or default catalogue is served: a stale annual rate must never reach a subscriber.
notes: Retries are safe: GET /v1/products and GET /v1/products/{code} are pure reads of static in-memory data.
4xx responses (including 404 for an unknown code) are never retried.
verification: Fault-injection test asserting the timeout, the retry count and the circuit-breaker transitions, plus a load test showing p99 inside the timeout.
